claims: C1 the voice_style section contains style guidelines specifically for audio and video conversations
C2 there are two separate systems for audio communication: Standard voice mode and Advanced voice mode

C3 Standard voice mode is the system where automatic speech recognition transcribes the user's voice into text and the assistant's textual responses are converted to speech via a separate text-to-speech system
C4 Advanced voice mode is the system where the assistant natively receives audio input and produces audio output, and the user may choose to share video with the assistant
